status: authored 2026-09-27 after the owner's decision (WATER_BUILD_PLAN.md section 13, decision 3: "The ferry IS the gate for players without a water mount"). Two lines are built offline (the Relic row, the Sound ferry: their docks exist on staging); the rest are data waiting for their docks. Generated by tools/ferries.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_ferries (world-local), its ferrymen placed by tools/reapply.py step R17F. Nothing here has run in a game: no click, charge or teleport is proven
source: docs/mechanics/WATER_PROPOSAL.md section 4 (4.2 the mechanism, 4.3 the lines), decisions 5 (fares) and 6 (gates); docs/mechanics/WATER_BUILD_PLAN.md section 11 (11.3: build it first at First Cast and Pacifidlog's jetty; the audit)

mechanism.what: a ferryman (a Cobblemon NPC) opens a compiled dialogue; each trip from that dock is an option, a gated one visible only to a player who meets its gates; the option runs a function as the player that checks the gates, checks the balance, refuses if short, charges the fare, verifies the charge, dismounts, fades and teleports to the far dock's landing. Per player: nobody is moved or charged by anyone else's choice
mechanism.rung: Cobblemon native (NPC dialogue, EXP-022) and a compatible addon (CobbleDollars' own commands, EXP-040) driven by a datapack's functions (rungs 1, 2 and 6 of CLAUDE.md principle 6). No moving boat (WATER_PROPOSAL 4.2 option C: client jitter, riders falling off, chunk loading), no script, no mod
mechanism.proven_parts: the dialogue compiler and per-player state (EXP-022, single player); an NPC placed by spawnnpcat after a restart (R9F, the Digger); the balance read (EXP-040); a function charging by the macro (EXP-042 run 1, $725 to $652); a function teleporting a player (EXP-042, the blackout return)
mechanism.not_proven: a player clicking a ferryman, a gated option hidden and shown by the flag probe, the trip's charge and teleport, two players at once (EXP-034's open multiplayer question), what a player's sent-out Pokemon does when its owner is teleported

swim_model.speed_basis: the measured sprint-swim (EXP-042 session 3, docs/STATE.md 'Swim speed, measured'), the speed tests/test_system_contracts.py C3 walks at
swim_model.constants: data/blackout.json surface (the owner's rule of 2026-09-27), stepped by tools/ferries.py swim() as tools/blackout_pack.py's surface/tick does
swim_model.gate_means: a crossing that knocks out (the second half-health hit) an unaided swimmer AND a trained one (Surf or Dive with a capable partner): only riding (a Pokemon, or a boat where boats may go) crosses it
swim_model.method: tests/test_system_contracts.py C3's: a straight line shore to shore, the water depth (sea level minus the rounded ground, tools/ground.py, with the islet and the sea town's decks laid over) per block, the rest cells at either end trimmed. Not modelled: a swimmer hopping skerries off the straight line; Slowness (the plan's reading is that it does not slow an unaided swimmer; not counting it is the conservative case for a gate)

trip.cooldown_why: a second submit of the same option (a double click, a lagging client) must not pay twice: the first sets the cooldown before the charge, the second is refused silently; 2 s is shorter than any walk back to a ferryman
trip.fade_why: vanilla has no screen fade: blindness hides the jump and lifts on arrival, the title names where the player is. Immediate, so there is no pending state to lose on a disconnect

messages.voice: PLACEHOLDERS for Codex's voice (the ferrymen's greetings are on the docks). Placeholders: {destination}, {line}, {fare}, {requirement}, and {balance} in 'short' only
messages.short: The crossing to {destination} is ${fare}. You have ${balance}.
messages.gated: The {line} only takes passengers who have {requirement}.
messages.charge_failed: The fare did not go through, so the boat stays in. Check your balance before you try again.

lines.name: Tilpey launch

gates.why: WATER_PROPOSAL decision 6: the launch belongs to EVT-G6-SLOWPOKE-FERRY and SQ-G6-02, after Sabrina

swim.why: UNSITED because this tool cannot walk it. tools/ferries.py walks every crossing at data/world.json's sea level 62; the Tilpey launch crosses a LAKE whose surface is y77 (measured from Uxie's record in data/legendaries.json), so its water is never found and the swim can neither be declared a gate nor a leak. Its three docks ARE built (2026-09-30) and its ferrymen stand on them; the line is simply not offered until somebody teaches ferries.py a per-crossing water level and walks it. Until then it is held by emitted_lines(), not silently emitted with an unmeasured crossing.
